ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The map on the left is an oval park path. Inside it there are three objects: at the lower left there is a low half-dome, at the upper-left side there is a tall cylinder, and on the right side there is a cone. The starting point is marked above the oval, between the cylinder and the cone, and the arrow points right along the upper edge. Among the four photos on the right: Photo 1 shows the half-dome on the left and the cylinder and cone overlapping on the right; Photo 2 shows the cone on the left and the half-dome and cylinder on the right; Photo 3 shows the cylinder and cone on the left and the half-dome on the right; Photo 4 shows the cylinder on the left, the half-dome in the middle slightly lower, and the cone on the right. Reasoning: The arrow above the oval points to the right, indicating that Betty starts from the upper position and walks clockwise around the park. Looking into the park from the upper side, right side, lower side, and left side in clockwise order: from the upper viewpoint, the cone is on the left, and the cylinder and half-dome are on the right, corresponding to Photo 2; from the right-side viewpoint, the half-dome is on the left, and the cylinder and cone overlap on the right, corresponding to Photo 1; from the lower viewpoint, the cylinder is on the left, the half-dome is in the middle, and the cone is on the right, corresponding to Photo 4; from the left-side viewpoint, the cylinder and cone are on the left, and the half-dome is on the right, corresponding to Photo 3. Therefore the order is 2143.
